prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1442; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 reported that a vehicle in the adjacent lane drifted into their lane while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, causing a sideswipe collision. Driver 1 was operating a sedan with a Passenger seated in the front passenger seat at the time of the impact. Driver 1 stated that they experienced lower back strain immediately after the collision and was assessed at the scene. The reported injury is consistent with the type and force of a lateral impact of this nature. Physical damage to the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle is consistent with the described impact. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several of the reported details, although a few older scratches elsewhere on the vehicle may predate this incident and were noted for reference only. No independent witnesses were identified. Responding officers and other persons on scene confirmed that Driver 1 and the Passenger were both inside the vehicle at the time of the collision. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the policy in force at the time of the incident. The second vehicle's operator, Driver 2, was issued a citation for failure to maintain a single lane.
